_comment: Versioned corrected environment contract; exact original CUDA executable and canonical SmolGGUF; prior HALTED preserved; no gate changes.

jobs.name: hf_cuda_smol_v3
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz converter.tgz smol_manifest.json native_cuda_binary launch_contract_v3.py COMMITS hf_cuda_vm.sh INPUT_SHA256SUMS; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/hf_cuda_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
